english.notes:
(i) This offence document and associated codes should only be used for offences committed on or after 14th July 2014 and before 16th May 2019. On 16th May 2019, a further weapon and device were added under section 5(1)(ag) and (ba). For offences committed on or after 16th May 2019, see document H20251.
(ii) See related offences regarding distribution of prohibited weapons - H11538 (sell/transfer), H11539 (possess for sale/transfer) and H11540 (purchase/acquire for sale/transfer).
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
